title: When Life Gives You Tangerines
tagline: Dedicated to you. Still blooming, always dreaming.
synopsis: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

episodes.title: Spring in a Heartbeat
episodes.synopsis: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae-sun has dreams bigger than her village — until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

episodes.title: Sassy First Love
episodes.synopsis: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

episodes.title: Yesterday Was Your Spring
episodes.synopsis: After a dramatic rescue, Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate — leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

episodes.title: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
episodes.synopsis: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness — can they find a path to peace?

episodes.title: A Midsummer Night's Full Nets
episodes.synopsis: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family — until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

episodes.title: Life Goes on and On
episodes.synopsis: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything — testing their will to carry on.

episodes.title: A Fruitful Fall
episodes.synopsis: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

episodes.title: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains
episodes.synopsis: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

episodes.title: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
episodes.synopsis: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

episodes.title: The Storm Sweeps My Heart, the Love Rocks My Heart
episodes.synopsis: While Geum-myeong grows closer to her quirky colleague, Ae-sun's troubling dreams stir real concerns. Do they hold any meaning?

episodes.title: My Love by My Side
episodes.synopsis: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt — will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

episodes.title: A Glistening Winter
episodes.synopsis: Back in Jeju, Geum-myeong mends her heart in familiar surroundings. Ae-sun treasures sweet moments with her loved ones.
